About Toolstack Lab Games

Toolstack Lab Games is where Toolstack Lab publishes the small 3D browser games it makes. Every game is our own; press Play and it loads right in the page. No accounts, no cookies, no third-party scripts or fonts.

TSL

What you get

  • Self-made games with recorded licence and source in each detail page.
  • Iframe docks only after Play — nothing heavy loads until you ask (or open in a new tab).
  • Popularity sorted by a documented formula; “recently played” stays on your device only.

Lab cartridge workbench

Every game gets the same cartridge card with a label plate. On a mouse, hovering a card flips its label to a real screenshot. Play docks the cartridge into the bay — one memorable beat, no video or 3D backgrounds.

Audience & boundaries

Pip's Bloom Isle is aimed at casual players 13+. We only list what each build already ships. See the content policy for licence rules.
